name: Shoot or Shout
detailed_description:
Embark on a wild and wacky adventure in Shoot or Shout, a side view roguelite experience that pits you against a horde of eccentric enemies across multiple dimensions! In this pixel-art extravaganza, you'll take control of two intrepid heroes tasked with battling bizarre foes using a unique arsenal of weapons and vocal abilities.

As you journey through meticulously crafted levels, each brimming with its own challenges and surprises, you'll need to master the art of precision shooting and strategic shouting to survive. Whether unleashing a hail of bullets or letting out a thunderous scream, your survival depends on quick reflexes and clever tactics.

But beware, for the realms you'll traverse are filled with outlandish adversaries unlike anything you've ever encountered. From mischievous minions to colossal bosses, every encounter promises a test of skill. Adapt to each enemy's quirks and exploit their weaknesses to emerge victorious!

With its retro-inspired pixel art and addictive gameplay, Shoot or Shout offers endless hours of thrilling action and unpredictable fun. So gear up, and get ready to blast, bellow, and battle your way through a multiverse of madness!

short_description: A rogue-lite action game where you need to choose when to shoot or shout at wacky enemies to keep them from eating you! Earn dozens of powerups to help you defeat unique bosses across dimensions.
